name: template-language
body:
Template language: layouts (`layout.html.tmpl`) are standard Go html/template only — no third-party template engine, no Sprig.
- Content arrives pre-rendered: the body, `text` fields (inline Markdown) and each named section (rendered through its section template) are passed as safe HTML. Other fields are passed as typed values: number/date already formatted per their `_format`, boolean, enum, list, image/link URLs.
- Layouts never parse or render Markdown; there is no markdown helper.
- The custom function set is minimal and centrally defined and documented. v1 has exactly one helper: `media "path"`, resolving a file in `templates/media/` or the theme directory to its served URL. Adding a helper is a spec change.
- Layouts have no file, environment or network access.
- Layout parse and execute errors are file:line-qualified templates errors (parse at templates-dir-validation step 3; execute errors during example/deck render reported as templates errors).
AC: a layout using any function other than the documented set fails to parse with a file:line templates error; a layout referencing `{{media "logo.svg"}}` renders the served URL; body/text/section values render unescaped as HTML while other string values are auto-escaped.
